summary: Savers Value Village, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement, entered into on June 2, 2026. The amendment reduces the Applicable Rate on term loans to 2.50% for Term SOFR Loans and 1.50% for Base Rate Loans. This is a routine refinancing of debt terms, not a special situation transaction. No change of control, tender offer, share repurchase, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a standard material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation disclosure with no special-situations relevance.
